http/selected_connection#

Select an enabled conversation from actual ALPN, or explicit cleartext policy.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

Select an enabled conversation from actual ALPN, or explicit cleartext policy. Every TCP attempt uses the exact previously checked numeric endpoint; no second lookup occurs. Bounded staggered TCP racing closes every losing attempt before publication.
